prompt: The third and final stage of the reference creature, for a monster-collecting RPG: a large, graceful guardian ferret whose long body flows in an S-curve like a lightning bolt as it rears up tall and protective. The same soft cream-white fur and pastel pink ferret mask across the eyes, pink inner ears, a trail of tiny pink stars down its back, and a glowing pink star-shaped gem set in the centre of its chest. Paw pads glowing pale gold; a huge fluffy bottle-brush tail crackling with pale-gold electricity. Calm, kind, watchful eyes: a protector. Three-quarter view facing right. Crisp dark outline, clean clustered pixel shading. Not a mouse, not a rabbit, not a cat, not a dragon, not yellow, no red cheeks, no clothing, no armour. Exactly one creature on a plain white background.
